If called function is synchronous then service is synchronous. May cause rescheduling. Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Function Index Index of the function to be called. Function Params Pointer to the parameters for the function - specified by the Function Index - to be called. If no parameters are provided, a NULL pointer has to be passed. Parameters (inout) None Par ameters (out) None Return value Status Type E_ OK: No Error E_ OS_ SERVICEID: No function defined for this index Description A (trusted or non - trusted) OS - Application uses this service to call a trusted function Available via Os.h
